name: @reticlehq/server
description: Reticle CLI, bridge and MCP server: a coding agent drives your running web app from the inside and gets a verdict with evidence, for change verification, access control, accessibility, performance and SEO checks.

scripts.prepack: node ../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs --clean dist && tsc -b --force && node ../scripts/alias-dist.mjs && node ../scripts/prepare-dist.mjs dist && node ../scripts/stamp-issuer-key.mjs && node ../scripts/pack-docs.mjs

author: Reticle contributors

reticle.changelog: Drive your localhost app from the Reticle platform's chat: the daemon of a linked project drives it on your machine, the chat shows it live and keeps it as a check with a replay. The Harness now runs only on the platform, on every plan, and plans, replays and learns each app. A page on SDK 3.1-3.4 is no longer version-skewed, a pressed key sends its keyCode, and a screenshot never carries another tab's pixels. Upgrading from 3.5: see MIGRATION.md.
breakingChanges: reticle_verify { action: "explore" } and reticle verify --explore no longer drive on a model key of your own. The Harness decides on the Reticle platform and needs a linked project (npx @reticlehq/server connect); every plan includes Harness credits. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and JEV_API_KEY are no longer read for driving, RETICLE_HARNESS_DRIVER and RETICLE_HARNESS_MODEL are ignored, and the explore tool's `driver` argument is removed. A secret field's value comes from RETICLE_SECRET_<FIELD> on your machine.
